description: Return one of this site's own articles. Output is { slug, markdown }. markdown is the article file with YAML front matter, and the same text is the tool content. Parameter slug is required and must match articles[].slug from list_articles. Example: machine-native-economy. Do not include the article: prefix that list_changes uses. A missing slug is rejected as invalid input. An unknown slug returns isError with text No article with slug <slug>. A failed read returns isError whose text is the Error message (Fetch failed <status> <url> when the HTTP status is not OK), or Article fetch failed. when the failure is not an Error. Use list_articles instead when you do not have a slug. Use get_source instead for a third-party library source. Use search_sources instead to find papers and docs. Free, no auth.

slug.description: Required. Article slug exactly as in list_articles articles[].slug, e.g. machine-native-economy. Lowercase words separated by hyphens. Do not include the article: prefix that list_changes uses. A missing slug is invalid input. An unknown slug returns isError text No article with slug <slug>.

name: get_article
title: Read one article
